machine.topology: benchmark client and actor runtime on this machine; Postgres at BENCH_DATABASE_URL

scenarios.name: subscriptions
scenarios.description: Cross-actor subscriptions: the hand-rolled intent fan-out baseline; the publisher's turn beside 1 to 1,024 subscriptions; commit-to-delivery latency, awake and hibernated; one pair's throughput; fan-in; subscribe churn; a backlog drain across 64 subscribers; the retention pass beside 10,000 subscriptions; and lag beside one poison row.
